title: VoiceVPN
subtitle: Android VPN app interface
challenge: The app interface needed to make connection state, server choice, and privacy status immediately clear without making the VPN experience feel technical or heavy.
solution: The design centers the connection action, uses strong status feedback, and keeps server details compact so users can understand protection state at a glance.

title: Vasilkoff.com
subtitle: Marketing website
challenge: Vasilkoff.com needed to make the company's AI-empowered development positioning clearer while keeping the message practical: AI improves speed, but the team remains accountable for quality, testing, and delivery.
solution: The site was shaped around service clarity, trust-building portfolio proof, AI chat entry points, and direct paths from interest to project estimation.

title: Beauty Life
subtitle: Beauty ecommerce concept
challenge: Beauty and ecommerce interfaces need to feel polished while still guiding visitors toward product discovery, trust, and purchase decisions.
solution: The design uses clean ecommerce structure, soft visual hierarchy, and product-focused composition to support a calm shopping journey across devices.

title: Inter Euro Investments
subtitle: Corporate WordPress website
challenge: The firm needed a digital presence that projected trust, professionalism, and clarity without becoming generic or visually overworked.
solution: Vasilkoff delivered a lightweight WordPress website with a restrained corporate interface, structured service content, and an easy path from research to contact.

title: Divine Beauty Studio
subtitle: Brand book and identity
challenge: A beauty brand needs a visual system that can stay consistent across logo usage, stationery, color, social media, and service presentation.
solution: The brand book defines a soft, elegant identity system with logo rules, color usage, and customer-facing assets that keep the studio recognisable across touchpoints.

title: SmartAIChats
subtitle: AI chat SaaS website
challenge: The product needed to communicate practical AI chat value without becoming another generic chat widget pitch, while also supporting lead capture and support automation.
solution: Vasilkoff built a business-facing conversational SaaS experience focused on fast setup, consistent answers, first-line support, and qualified visitor engagement.

title: Vasilkoff Brand Book
subtitle: IT company identity system
challenge: The Vasilkoff identity needed to work across technical services, marketing pages, app icons, presentations, and client-facing proof material.
solution: The brand book standardizes logo usage, app icon behavior, color palette, typography, and supporting visuals so the company presents one consistent design language.
